newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Man killed in Geneva airport shooting - police.
newsitem.headline: Man killed in Geneva airport shooting - police.

text.p: A man was killed in a shooting incident at Geneva's Cointrin international airport on Monday, police said.
They said the incident took place during the morning. They declined to give any further details immediately, but called a news conference for 5 p.m. (1600 GMT).
Airport officials said all information would come from the police, but one source said the incident took place in a public area.
A foreign airline official said there was no sign of unusual police activity in the early afternoon at the airport, which straddles the border between Switzerland and France on the edge of the city.
